title: Sentiment-Aware Measure (SAM) for Evaluating Sentiment Transfer by Machine Translation Systems
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical problem of accurately translating sentiment in text. While some examples use religious language (e.g., 'God would forgive him' or 'May God bless you'), they serve only to illustrate sentiment shifts (e.g., anger vs. sympathy) in machine translation outputs. The paper does not evaluate, benchmark, or analyze religious, moral, or ethical concepts as its primary subject.
